# Getting Support

Thank you for your interest in the **GMAHK Galilea Web Portal**.

This project is actively maintained as the digital portal and worship resource platform for GMAHK Jemaat Galilea.

---

## Technical Issues & Bug Reports

If you encountered a bug, broken interface, or unexpected error:
1. Search existing [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/zvenians/gmahk-galilea/issues) to verify if the issue has already been reported.
2. If new, open a structured report using the [Bug Report Template](https://github.com/zvenians/gmahk-galilea/issues/new?template=bug_report.md).
3. Include your browser version, device type, steps to reproduce, and screenshots if applicable.

---

## Feature Requests & Enhancements

Suggestions and architectural proposals are welcome:
1. Open an issue using the [Feature Request Template](https://github.com/zvenians/gmahk-galilea/issues/new?template=feature_request.md).
2. Clearly explain the pastoral or functional use case and how it benefits congregational workflows.

---

## Security Vulnerabilities

Please **do not** report security vulnerabilities or exposure risks via public issues:
* Refer to our [Security Policy](https://github.com/zvenians/gmahk-galilea/security/policy).
* Privately report vulnerabilities via GitHub Security Advisories or by contacting the lead maintainer directly at **simatupangkevin9@gmail.com**.

---

## Congregational & Administrative Inquiries

For official church administrative inquiries, pastoral care, or worship schedule coordination:
* Visit the live portal: [gmahk-galilea.vercel.app](https://gmahk-galilea.vercel.app)
* Contact the GMAHK Galilea church secretariat or pastoral leadership through official congregational channels.
